index.title: Identify Repetitive Tasks Across Multiple Platforms
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Automation Scout. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Identify Repetitive Tasks Across Multiple Platforms. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user connected multiple platforms and had a tool inspect their history to identify repetitive tasks and propose automations to streamline them. This job is a public pattern.
